sents.zh: 清朝快要过去的时候，中国有很多难事。
sents.en: As the Qing dynasty neared its end, China faced many difficulties.

sents.zh: 那时候，西边的国家做出了新的船。
sents.en: By then countries in the west had built new ships.

sents.zh: 他们的船又大又快，不用风也可以走。
sents.en: Their ships were large and fast, and could move without wind.

sents.zh: 他们也有新的东西，是中国没有的。
sents.en: They had new things that China did not.

sents.zh: 因为这样，中国过了几十年很难的日子。
sents.en: Because of this, China went through several very hard decades.

sents.zh: 很多人开始想：我们应该怎么办？
sents.en: Many began to ask: what should we do?

sents.zh: 有的人说，我们要学西边的学问。
sents.en: Some said we must learn the west’s knowledge.

sents.zh: 所以一些官开始做新的学校。
sents.en: So some officials began founding new schools.

sents.zh: 学校里教数，也教别的国家的话。
sents.en: Those schools taught numbers, and other countries’ languages.

sents.zh: 他们也送年轻人出去读书。
sents.en: They also sent young people abroad to study.

sents.zh: 那些年轻人回来以后，做了很多事情。
sents.en: Those young people did a great deal after they returned.

sents.zh: 有的人做船，有的人做路。
sents.en: Some built ships, some built roads.

sents.zh: 做这些事情非常不容易。
sents.en: Doing all this was far from easy.

sents.zh: 虽然很多次都没有成功，但是他们没有放弃。
sents.en: Although they failed many times, they did not give up.

sents.zh: 他们的想法影响了后来的中国。
sents.en: Their thinking shaped the China that came after.
